description: A tabletop is covered with scattered black card sleeves (plus one red sleeve) and several small stacks of trading cards. The left hand gathers and holds a sleeve open while the right hand repeatedly picks up a card from the piles, aligns it with the sleeve opening, slides it inside, then grips and pulls the card back out again; both hands come together on the card-and-sleeve briefly to square the edges before the right hand sets the card down and reaches for the next.
